about.android.intro: Tactics, positional judgement, endgame technique and coached play, with the engine running on the device itself. No account, and nothing collected — apart from what online play needs: a nickname, your online ratings, and the friends you make.
about.android.includes: It includes Stockfish, which is GPLv3. Because it is linked into the app, the whole application carries AGPLv3 — and its complete source is published.
about.android.privacy: Apart from online play, the app collects nothing and sends nothing about you. Your training ratings and history are stored only on this device, and deleting the app deletes them.
about.android.online: Online play is the exception. It uses a game service of ours: your nickname, your online rating on each clock and the friends you make are kept there, under a random key made on this device — no e-mail address, phone number or advertising identifier is asked for or sent. While the app is on your screen it also says that you are online, looking for a game or in one; that is forgotten five minutes after you leave. Settings → Delete online account removes all of it.
